up: Return the first 200 metabolism records for Homo sapiens. For each record, include the substrate structure (canonical SMILES), substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion description, pathway key, and enzyme name. Retrieve records where the organism is 'Homo sapiens'. Join metabolism records with compound structures and records to get substrate structures and names.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure,
  cr_sub.compound_name AS substrate_name,
  cr_par.compound_name AS parent_name,
  m.met_conversion AS metabolic_conversion,
  m.pathway_key AS pathway,
  m.enzyme_name AS enzyme
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_par ON m.drug_record_id = cr_par.record_id
WHERE m.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
LIMIT 200;
